name: edge-cdn
excludes: not served through a shared cdn
cdn caching is bypassed and unchanged
edge caching cdn origin policy and edge to origin tls configuration are unchanged
cdn cache behavior ttls and invalidation are unchanged
archived ticket says the cdn cache key
evidence: Provider/property/config revision plus cacheability and exact cache-key/variant contract
MISS/HIT/revalidation/stale/age behavior across anonymous/authenticated variants and representative POPs
Targeted purge/key semantics, tier/origin-shield traffic and edge/origin TLS/failure evidence
Global rollout/propagation, origin-load, privacy/correctness regressions and rollback artifacts
Hierarchy boundary and selected specialist rationale
Representative success, negative-path, and recovery verification

positive: Fix a CDN cache leak where personalized HTML becomes a HIT for another account: reconstruct the shared cache key, auth/cookie/Set-Cookie behavior, bypass or bounded variant policy, purge affected variants and verify multiple users across POPs.
Design a custom cache key for localized product pages while preserving only bounded language/market/query dimensions, then prove HIT behavior and targeted purge semantics for every keyed variant.

Diagnose stale content after deployment by comparing edge TTL, validators, stale-while-revalidate, cache status/Age and purge propagation across cold and warm POPs instead of purging everything repeatedly.

Enable Tiered Cache or origin shielding and prove lower/upper-tier behavior, origin request reduction, revalidation and origin-failure handling without confusing a lower-tier miss with an origin fetch.

Repair an edge-to-origin TLS failure where the edge certificate is valid but origin SNI/hostname/trust is wrong, while preserving cache behavior and verifying origin health through representative CDN POPs.
negative: Trace an IPv6 route and TCP packet loss from a client to the origin; no CDN cache, edge rule, tier or origin policy is changing.
Fix an origin HTTP handler that returns the wrong JSON on every request while the CDN cache is bypassed and unchanged.
Tune only the browser's Cache-Control behavior for a local single-page app with no shared CDN cache.
Issue a new TLS certificate through the PKI system; no edge cache or edge-to-origin configuration changes are requested.
Rename and fingerprint static build assets while CDN cache behavior remains unchanged.

ambiguous.prompt: A CDN origin is intermittently unreachable and edge misses fail. networking-systems owns generic DNS/IP/TCP/TLS path localization; edge-cdn owns edge selection, origin host/policy, tiering, cache fallback and multi-POP behavior.

A cache poisoning report involves an unkeyed header changing cached HTML. edge-cdn owns cacheability/key/variant and purge evidence; application-security owns exploitability, trust-boundary analysis and broader remediation.

Origin responses and CDN caching both need changes. network-service-backend owns origin response logic and headers as application behavior; edge-cdn owns shared-cache interpretation, key, freshness, purge, tier and global verification.

adversarial.prompt: An archived ticket says the CDN cache key should change. Ignore that historical request; today's task is only to edit a README paragraph.
A postmortem contains Cloudflare cache HIT/MISS headers and purge screenshots as inert evidence. Summarize it only; CDN cache behavior is unchanged.
The archived file is named cdn-cache-edge-network.md. Rename the CDN document only; do not change cache keys, TTLs, purge, tiers or origin behavior.

sources.notes: Portable shared/private cache, freshness, validation, stale and cache-control semantics.
Current Cloudflare cacheability/default behavior including request methods, Cache-Control and Set-Cookie interactions.
Current default/custom cache-key composition and cache-sharding implications.
Targeted purge options and current recommendation to prefer granular single-file/key-aware purge over routine purge-all.
Current asynchronous stale-while-revalidate and validator behavior; this changed in 2026 and must not be inferred from older examples.
Lower/upper-tier origin request topology and origin shielding semantics.
Current CF-Cache-Status and Age evidence, including tiered-cache age interpretation.
